title: Milestone 5: ergonomic VC4Tile surface, copy planner, and 32-bit tile compute
locked_goal: Make VC4Tile a real ergonomic tile-kernel layer above SSAVC4 while preserving vc4tile -> ssavc4 -> scheduled vc4 -> artifacts/runtime. M5 has no producer lowering and no executable sub-32 precision.

slices.title: M5 milestone package
slices.intent: Install and validate the M5 descriptor, worklist, verification spec, context profiles, prompt package, design documents, and mechanism smoke. No compiler implementation source is allowed in this slice.
non_goals: Do not implement Triton/IREE/StableHLO/JAX/PyTorch/Torch-MLIR/MLIR-gpu producer lowering in M5.
Do not lower vc4tile directly to scheduled vc4.
Do not implement executable sub-32 precision in M5.
Do not special-case fixtures or fake hardware results.
Do not weaken M2/M3/M4 regressions.
